title: mcpwn.lock
description: Cross-session rug-pull PIN lockfile (§3.14/A3). `mcpwn pin capture` hashes a server's whole advertised surface (tools + resources + prompts) into this file; `--pin <file>` then diffs later runs against it and raises a HIGH finding on any silent drift. Hashes are sha256 over canonicalised JSON, so the lock never stores or diffs full text and key/entry order never matters.

capturedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the surface was pinned.

resources.description: Pinned resources/list entries (identity = resource uri, else name).

name.description: Stable identity key for the advertised item.

descriptionHash.description: sha256 of the item's description text.

shapeHash.description: sha256 over canonical JSON of the item's shape: inputSchema (tools), {uri,name,mimeType} (resources) or arguments (prompts).

raw.description: The raw advertised item as captured, for human review.
